reviewer_v2_output_schema.reviewer_v2_expected_alpha_id: one canonical alpha_id (material_fit=true) or the literal string NONE (material_fit=false)

reviewer_v2_invariant: material_fit=false <=> expected_alpha_id=NONE; material_fit=true <=> expected_alpha_id is a real canonical Alpha ID. Enforced by hard validation (INVARIANT_VIOLATION_* errors) in the reviewer script, not just prompted.
reviewer_v2_two_stage_procedure_summary: STAGE 1 (material-fit gate): does the Evidence materially express/support/oppose/instantiate/reason about at least one canonical Alpha's own core causal/economic mechanism? Shared words, generic bullish/bearish language, a technical indicator alone, a stock-specific recommendation alone, a catalyst alone, or a price move alone are explicitly insufficient. Core thesis has semantic priority over trigger/confirmation signals and keywords -- signals help recognize a thesis, they never substitute for it (worked example: technical momentum alone does not establish A601 Narrative Momentum, which requires the attention/narrative/crowding/flow mechanism itself). No material fit => material_fit=false, expected_alpha_id=NONE (a valid, complete, non-penalized result). STAGE 2 (single best, only if Stage 1 found >=1 materially-fitting Alpha): compare all materially-fitting Alphas and select the single best one; NONE is never used merely because the choice between two-or-more valid Alphas is close (uncertainty about WHICH Alpha != uncertainty about WHETHER any Alpha exists). Explicit anti-bias instruction included: clearly-expressed short/plain-worded evidence must not become NONE merely because it is brief.
